paragraphs: R. Mattanah expounded in Pappunya: one kneads only with water that has stayed overnight, etc., Pesaḥim 42a. Yuḥasin writes Rav Matun. The Pappunyans asked him about finding a nest on a person's head, Ḥullin קל״ע b [irregular source folio retained]. R. Abba and R. Yose bar Abba asked Rav Mattanah and Rav Yehudah, Berakhot 11b. R. Abba bar Kahana, R. Berekhya and R. Zeira in his name, Jerusalem Talmud, Ta'anit 3, halakhah 12. R. Abba bar Mammal. He spoke to Abaye, Shabbat 2b. Rav Ashi said, 'I stated the teaching before Rav Mattanah' [אמריתו in the Warsaw text], Zevaḥim 29a: this is the early Rav Ashi. R. Berekhya: see above. Rav Huna bar Ḥiyya. Rav Huna bar Minyomi before him. R. Zeira said: R. Mattanah said: Shemuel said, Ketubbot 43b; Berakhot 36a; Shabbat 21b; Menaḥot 33a. R. Zeira said: R. Mattanah said: Rav said, Ketubbot 43b. R. Zeira: see above. R. Ḥelbo and R. Yose bar Menasha, Jerusalem Talmud, Makkot 2, halakhah 3. Rav Ḥana sent before him. R. Ḥinena and R. Parnakh. He transmitted a teaching of Rav Ḥisda, Kiddushin 32a. Rav Yehudah was his colleague (see his entry). R. Yose bar Menasha and R. Yose bar Abba: see above. R. Yitzḥak bar Shila said: R. Mattanah said. In Levi's name (see shortly below). He did not come to Nehardea for thirteen years; Rav Naḥman spoke to him (see Rav Yehudah). Mar Ukva, in Levi and Shemuel's father's name, Shabbat 108b; Mo'ed Katan 26b. R. Amram; R. Ba bar Mammal in Rav's name, Jerusalem Talmud, Makkot 1, halakhah 5. R. Parnakh: see above. In Rav's name (see above). Rabbah said: R. Mattanah said, Bava Kamma 56b. Rabbah bar Shila said: R. Mattanah said. Ravina bar Shila was his student. Shemuel said, Sukkah 11b; see above. Shemuel told him, 'Do not sit down until you explain it to me,' Makkot 13b. R. Shemuel bar Naḥman.
